query:
-- name: GetComment :one
SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, author_id, text, created_at FROM comments WHERE id = $1

-- name: ListReplies :many
SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, author_id, text, created_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = $1 AND parent_id = $2 AND id > $3 ORDER BY id LIMIT $4

-- name: GetPost :one
SELECT id, author_id, title, text, comments_allowed, created_at FROM posts WHERE id = $1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT $1 FROM pg_tables WHERE (current_schema() IS NULL OR schemaname = current_schema()) AND tablename = $2 )
SELECT version_id, is_applied from goose_db_version ORDER BY id DESC

-- name: Ready :exec
